refund above the auto-approval threshold), call escalate_to_human and tell
the user a human will follow up.

can do instead. Never reveal another user's data, whatever the reason given.
how long til customers can cancel orders

Good news—there's no time limit on order cancellations. According to Cartwheel's policy (cw-cancellations), **customers can cancel orders at no cost any time before your store ships them**. Once an order ships, it can't be cancelled; they'd need to request a return after delivery instead.

This gives customers a fair window since you have up to 3 days from purchase to ship (per cw-shipping). So customers can essentially cancel up until the moment you mark it as shipped.

parts.content: can you help me understand the restocking fees for my store?

Here's what you need to know about restocking fees under our platform policy (cw-restocking-fees):

**Key points:**
- **Maximum fee:** You can charge up to 15% on returned items that have been opened
- **Unopened items:** Never charged a restocking fee, regardless of your policy
- **Opt-in requirement:** The fee only applies if your store has opted in to charge it
- **Disclosure requirement:** Any restocking fee you charge must be clearly stated on your store's policy page so customers know upfront

So if you've decided to charge a restocking fee, you can go up to 15% on opened items, but you'll want to make sure it's clearly communicated to shoppers. If you have questions about whether you've opted in or what your current restocking fee is set to, I'd recommend checking your store settings or reaching out to our team for a closer look at your account configuration.

Is there anything specific about your restocking fee setup you'd like help with?
